fullPassage: One of the main obstacles in anyone's quest for longevity is the fact that the skills that my colleagues and I acquired during our medical training have proved to be far more effective against fast death than slow death. We learned to fix broken bones, wipe out infections with powerful antibiotics, support and even replace damaged organs, and decompress serious spine or brain injuries. We had an amazing ability to save lives and restore full function to broken bodies, even reviving patients who were nearly dead. But we were markedly less successful at helping our patients with chronic conditions, such as cancer, cardiovascular disease, or neurological disease, evade slow death. We could relieve their symptoms and often delay the end slightly, but it didn't seem as if we could reset the clock the way we could with acute problems. We had become better at catching the eggs, but we had little ability to stop them from falling off the building in the first place.

questions.passage: One of the main obstacles in anyone's quest for longevity is the fact that the skills that my colleagues and I gained during our medical training have proved to be far more (A)[effective / ineffective] against fast death than slow death. We learned to fix broken bones, wipe out infections with powerful antibiotics, support and even replace damaged organs. We had an amazing ability to save lives and (B)[restore / destroy] full function to broken bodies, even reviving patients who were nearly dead. But we were (C)[markedly / slightly] less successful at helping our patients with chronic conditions evade slow death. We could relieve their symptoms and often delay the end slightly, but it didn't seem as if we could reset the clock the way we could with acute problems. We had become better at catching the eggs, but we had little ability to stop them from falling off the building in the first place.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ② effective — restore — markedly: 빠른 죽음에 '효과적'이고, 신체 기능을 '회복'시키며, 만성 질환에는 '현저하게' 덜 성공적.
❌ ① ineffective — restore — markedly: 빠른 죽음에 '비효과적'이면 이후 성공 사례 나열과 모순.
❌ ③ effective — destroy — markedly: 신체 기능을 '파괴'한다는 건 의료 목적과 반대.
❌ ④ effective — restore — slightly: '약간' 덜 성공적이면 대조의 강도가 약해 원문과 다름.
det.tip: effective(효과적인) ↔ ineffective(비효과적인). restore(회복시키다) ↔ destroy(파괴하다). markedly(현저하게) ↔ slightly(약간).

questions.passage: One of the main obstacles in anyone's quest for longevity is the fact that the skills that my colleagues and I acquired during our medical training have proved to be far more effective against fast death than slow death. We had an amazing ability to save lives, even reviving patients who were nearly dead. questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ① wipe out — chronic — relieve: 감염을 '박멸'하고, '만성' 질환에 덜 성공적이며, 증상을 '완화'할 수 있었다.
❌ ② spread — chronic — relieve: 감염을 '퍼뜨리다'는 의료 목적과 정반대.
❌ ③ wipe out — acute — relieve: '급성' 질환에 덜 성공적이면 원문과 반대(급성에 효과적).
❌ ④ wipe out — chronic — worsen: 증상을 '악화시키다'는 의료 목적과 반대.
det.tip: wipe out(박멸하다) ↔ spread(퍼뜨리다). chronic(만성적인) ↔ acute(급성의). relieve(완화하다) ↔ worsen(악화시키다).

questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ④ obstacles — acute — ability: 장수의 '장애물'이며, '급성' 문제에는 시계를 되돌릴 수 있었고, 예방할 '능력'이 부족했다.
❌ ① advantages — acute — ability: '장점'이면 장수를 방해한다는 맥락과 모순.
❌ ② obstacles — chronic — ability: '만성' 문제로 시계를 되돌릴 수 있다면 원문과 반대.
❌ ③ obstacles — acute — desire: '욕구'가 아니라 '능력'이 부족했다는 것이 핵심.
det.tip: obstacle(장애물) ↔ advantage(장점). acute(급성) ↔ chronic(만성). ability(능력) ≠ desire(욕구).

questions.stem: 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중에서 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.analysis:
❌ ① replace: 손상된 장기를 '교체하다' — 적절.
❌ ② amazing: '놀라운' 능력 — 적절.
❌ ③ evade: 느린 죽음을 '피하다' — 적절.
✅ ④ encourage: 원문은 stop(막다). 달걀이 떨어지는 것을 '격려하다'는 의미상 정반대.
det.tip: stop A from V-ing(A가 V하는 것을 막다) ↔ encourage A to V(A가 V하도록 격려하다).

questions.passage: One of the main obstacles in anyone's quest for longevity is the fact that our medical skills have proved to be far more effective against fast death than slow death. det.analysis:
❌ ① wipe out: 감염을 '박멸하다' — 적절.

❌ ④ relieve: 증상을 '완화하다' — 적절.
det.tip: chronic(만성적인) ↔ acute(급성의). cancer, cardiovascular disease = 만성 질환의 대표 사례.

questions.passage: One of the main obstacles in anyone's quest for ①<u>longevity</u> is the fact that our medical skills have proved to be far more effective against fast death than slow death. det.korean: at last(마침내) → in the first place(애초에).
det.analysis:
❌ ① longevity: '장수'에 대한 탐구 — 적절.
❌ ② decompress: 척추/뇌 부상의 압박을 '줄이다' — 적절.
❌ ③ delay: 최후를 '지연시키다' — 적절.
✅ ④ at last: 원문은 in the first place(애초에). '마침내'는 '처음부터/애초에'와 반대 의미. 달걀이 건물에서 '애초에' 떨어지지 않게 막는 능력.
det.tip: in the first place(애초에, 우선) ↔ at last(마침내, 결국). 예방 vs 사후 대응의 대조.

questions.passage: One of the main obstacles in anyone's quest for longevity is the fact that the skills that my colleagues and I acquired during our medical training have proved to be far more effective against fast death than slow death. det.analysis:
✅ ① organs: 손상된 '장기'를 교체한다 — 의료 맥락에서 replace damaged organs는 자연스러운 표현.
❌ ② symptoms: '증상'을 교체한다는 건 의학적으로 불가능.
❌ ③ antibiotics: '항생제'를 교체한다는 건 문맥과 맞지 않음.
❌ ④ patients: '환자'를 교체한다는 건 비윤리적.
det.tip: organ(장기) — 심장, 간, 폐 등 인체 기관. replace damaged organs = 손상된 장기를 교체하다.

✅ ③ symptoms: 만성 질환 환자의 '증상'을 완화한다 — relieve symptoms는 의학적 표현.
❌ ① infections: '감염'을 완화한다는 것보다 '증상'을 완화한다가 자연스러움.
❌ ② obstacles: '장애물'을 완화한다는 건 어색.
❌ ④ abilities: '능력'을 완화한다는 건 문맥에 맞지 않음.
det.tip: relieve symptoms(증상을 완화하다) — 의학에서 가장 흔한 표현. symptom(증상) ≠ disease(질병).

det.analysis:
✅ ② in the first place: 달걀이 건물에서 '애초에' 떨어지지 않게 막는 능력이 부족했다. 예방 vs 사후 대응의 핵심 대조.
❌ ① at the same time: '동시에'는 시간적 동시성으로, 예방의 맥락과 다름.
❌ ③ in the long run: '장기적으로'는 문맥과 약간 관련 있으나 원문의 '애초에' 의미를 놓침.
❌ ④ on the other hand: '반면에'는 대조를 나타내지만 비유의 완결과 맞지 않음.
det.tip: in the first place(애초에) — 질병이 발생하기 전에 예방하는 것. catching eggs(사후 대응) ↔ stopping them from falling(예방).

❌ ① solutions: '해결책'은 장애물의 반대.
❌ ② advantages: '이점'은 장애물과 대조적.
❌ ④ achievements: '성취'는 장애물과 무관.
det.tip: obstacle(장애물) = barrier, hindrance, impediment ↔ advantage(이점), solution(해결책).

questions.passage: We learned to fix broken bones, wipe out infections with powerful antibiotics, support and even replace damaged organs, and decompress serious spine or brain injuries. We had an amazing ability to save lives and <u>restore</u> full function to broken bodies, even reviving patients who were nearly dead. questions.stem: 밑줄 친 <u>restore</u>와 의미가 가장 가까운 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ② recover: '회복하다'로 restore와 동의어.
❌ ① damage: '손상시키다'는 회복의 반대.
❌ ③ abandon: '포기하다'는 맥락과 무관.
❌ ④ prevent: '예방하다'는 회복과 다른 행위.
det.tip: restore(회복시키다) = recover, repair, renew ↔ damage(손상시키다), ruin(파괴하다).

questions.passage: We had an amazing ability to save lives and restore full function to broken bodies, even reviving patients who were nearly dead. But we were <u>markedly</u> less successful at helping our patients with chronic conditions, such as cancer, cardiovascular disease, or neurological disease, evade slow death. questions.stem: 밑줄 친 <u>markedly</u>와 의미가 가장 가까운 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ① noticeably: '눈에 띄게'로 markedly와 동의어.
❌ ② slightly: '약간'은 markedly의 반의어.
❌ ③ occasionally: '가끔'은 빈도의 의미로 다름.
❌ ④ equally: '동등하게'는 차이를 나타내는 markedly와 반대 방향.
det.tip: markedly(현저하게) = noticeably, significantly, remarkably ↔ slightly(약간), insignificantly(미미하게).

questions.passage: We had an amazing ability to save lives and restore full function to broken bodies, even reviving patients who were nearly dead. But we were markedly less successful at helping our patients with <u>chronic</u> conditions, such as cancer, cardiovascular disease, or neurological disease, evade slow death. questions.stem: 밑줄 친 <u>chronic</u>와 의미가 가장 반대인 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ④ acute: '급성의'는 chronic(만성적인)의 정확한 반의어.
❌ ① severe: '심각한'은 만성/급성과 다른 축의 의미.
❌ ② terminal: '말기의'는 시간적 끝을 의미하며 반의어 아님.
❌ ③ infectious: '전염성의'는 질병 유형으로 반의어 관계 아님.
det.tip: chronic(만성적인) ↔ acute(급성의). 만성 = 오래 지속, 급성 = 갑자기 발생하여 빠르게 진행.

questions.passage: But we were markedly less successful at helping our patients with chronic conditions, such as cancer, cardiovascular disease, or neurological disease, evade slow death. We could <u>relieve</u> their symptoms and often delay the end slightly, but it didn't seem as if we could reset the clock the way we could with acute problems. We had become better at catching the eggs, but we had little ability to stop them from falling off the building in the first place.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 <u>relieve</u>와 의미가 가장 반대인 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ③ aggravate: '악화시키다'는 완화의 정확한 반의어.
❌ ① alleviate: '완화하다'는 relieve의 동의어.
❌ ② soothe: '진정시키다'도 relieve와 유사.
❌ ④ ease: '편하게 하다'도 relieve의 동의어.
det.tip: relieve(완화하다) = alleviate, soothe, ease ↔ aggravate(악화시키다), worsen(나빠지게 하다).

questions.passage:

(B) The knight embarked on a dangerous <u>quest</u> to find the legendary sword hidden in the mountains.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 (A)와 (B)의 quest가 의미하는 것으로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: (A) 탐구, 추구 (추상적 목표) (B) 탐색, 모험 (구체적 여정).
det.analysis:
✅ ② (A) 추구, 탐구 — (B) 탐색, 모험: (A)에서 quest는 장수를 '추구'하는 추상적 노력, (B)에서 quest는 전설의 검을 찾는 구체적 '모험'.
❌ ① (A) 질문 — (B) 탐색: quest는 question과 어원은 같지만 '질문'이라는 뜻은 아님.
❌ ③ (A) 추구 — (B) 요청: '요청(request)'과는 다름.
❌ ④ (A) 시험 — (B) 모험: quest에 '시험(test)'의 뜻은 없음.
det.tip: quest — 추구/탐구(pursuit, search for something important). quest for longevity = 장수를 위한 탐구.

다음 영영풀이에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은?

"to bring someone back to life or consciousness after they have been close to death"

det.analysis:

❌ ④ replace: '교체하다'는 생명 소생과 무관.
det.tip: revive(소생시키다) = resuscitate, rejuvenate. 거의 죽은 환자를 되살린다.

questions.passage: But we were markedly less successful at helping our patients with chronic conditions evade slow death. The __________ (effective) of modern medicine against chronic diseases remains limited.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오.

det.tip: effective(형용사) → effectiveness(명사) → effectively(부사). The effectiveness of ~ = ~의 효과성.

det.analysis: 빈칸 뒤에 동사 treat가 있으므로 동사를 수식하는 부사가 필요. success(명사) → successfully(부사). '급성 질환을 성공적으로 치료할 능력'.
det.tip: success(명사) → successful(형용사) → successfully(부사). 부사는 동사 앞에서 수식.

questions.passage: One of the main obstacles in anyone's quest for longevity is the fact that the skills that my colleagues and I acquired during our medical training have proved to be far more effective against __________ than slow death. We learned to fix broken bones, wipe out infections with powerful antibiotics, support and even replace damaged organs, and decompress serious spine or brain injuries. We had an amazing ability to save lives and restore full function to broken bodies, even reviving patients who were nearly dead. But we were markedly less successful at helping our patients with chronic conditions evade slow death. We could relieve their symptoms and often delay the end slightly.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ① fast death: 의료 기술이 '빠른 죽음'에 더 효과적이라는 대조 구조. 뒤에 slow death와 대비.
❌ ② chronic illness: '만성 질환'은 slow death 쪽에 해당.
❌ ③ mental health: '정신 건강'은 본문에서 다루지 않음.
❌ ④ natural aging: '자연 노화'는 빠른/느린 죽음의 대조와 맞지 않음.
det.tip: fast death(빠른 죽음) = 급성 질환/사고로 인한 사망. slow death(느린 죽음) = 만성 질환으로 인한 점진적 사망.

questions.passage: We had an amazing ability to save lives and restore full function to broken bodies, even reviving patients who were nearly dead. But we were markedly less successful at helping our patients with chronic conditions evade slow death. We could relieve their symptoms and often delay the end slightly, but it didn't seem as if we could reset the clock the way we could with acute problems. We had become better at __________, but we had little ability to stop them from falling off the building in the first place.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ② catching the eggs: 달걀을 '받는' 것(사후 대응)에는 능숙해졌지만 '떨어지지 않게 막는' 것(예방)에는 무능했다는 비유.
❌ ① building the walls: '벽 쌓기'는 원문 비유와 무관.
❌ ③ climbing the ladder: '사다리 오르기'도 비유와 맞지 않음.
❌ ④ counting the birds: '새 세기'는 문맥과 무관.
det.tip: catching the eggs(달걀 받기) = 사후 대응/치료. stopping them from falling(떨어지지 않게 막기) = 예방. 의학의 한계를 비유적으로 표현.
